Which ZIP code areas stretch across the most counties?
SELECT geoid_zcta5_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_county_20) AS counties FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 WHERE coalesce(geoid_zcta5_20, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of audited federal awards are tested as major programs?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_major AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards
What kinds of schedule violations do water discharge permit holders commit most?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_ps_violations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many papers are indexed under Alzheimer Disease?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Alzheimer Disease'
Which industry codes are listed most often as the primary business of SAM.gov registrants?
SELECT primary_naics, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many metropolitan and how many micropolitan areas are there?
SELECT CASE cast(cbsa_type AS varchar) WHEN '1' THEN 'metropolitan' ELSE 'micropolitan' END AS kind, count(DISTINCT geoid) AS areas FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_cbsa GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which utilities operate the most generators?
SELECT utility_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of working residents of the Bronx earned $1,250 a month or less in 2019?

SELECT sum(ce01) AS low_wage, sum(c000) AS all_workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'ny' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36005'
What did the Department of Health and Human Services spend the most on in contracts in fiscal 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND upper(awarding_agency_name) = 'DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES' AND product_or_service_code_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Schedule H filers ended the year with more than $1 billion in net assets?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_h WHERE try_cast(net_assets_eoy_amt AS double) > 1000000000
Which health and welfare rates appear most often in service contract wage determinations?
SELECT health_welfare, count(*) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much have companies spent on cleanup and compliance under EPA enforcement cases?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_comp_action_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements
Which laws account for the most Judgment Fund payments?

SELECT principal_citation_desc, sum(try_cast(confirmed_payment_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_treasury.jfics_congress_report WHERE principal_citation_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of reactions taken from published applications change from 2002 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2002', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which California cities appear most often as inventor locations on granted patents?
SELECT raw_city, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country = 'US' AND raw_state = 'CA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the Southwest Power Pool's electricity came from wind in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) / sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw AS double)), 1) AS wind_pct FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'SWPP' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which companies sold the most electricity in wholesale markets in 2023?

SELECT seller_company_name, round(sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2023%' AND product_name = 'ENERGY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many corrective action plans are on file with the audit clearinghouse?
Which counties have the largest Hispanic citizen voting-age population?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE lntitle = 'Hispanic or Latino' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many master reactions does Rhea define?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_directions
Which ERCOT buses carry the highest average day-ahead prices in the bus price records?
Ercot Lmp By Bus Dam Cdr Damhrlmpnp
SELECT busname, avg(try_cast(lmp AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.ercot_lmp_by_bus_dam_cdr_damhrlmpnp WHERE busname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total number of jobs based in San Francisco County in 2021?
SELECT sum(c000) AS total FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ca' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2021 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '06075'
Which states have the largest share of veterans among adults?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_veterans FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b21001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies filed an electric quarterly report for the second quarter of 2016?
SELECT count(DISTINCT company_id_ferc) AS companies FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_quarterly_identity WHERE year_quarter = '2016q2'
Which New York counties have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judicial confirmations were there each year from 2005 to 2014?

SELECT substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2005' AND '2014' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which parent companies own the most toxic-release reporting facilities?
SELECT _17_standard_parent_co_name, count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _17_standard_parent_co_name <> 'NA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of caffeine?
SELECT m.c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = m.c0 WHERE t.c1 = 'Caffeine'
Which countries are home to the most research institutions in OpenAlex?
SELECT country_code, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions WHERE country_code <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Medicare-enrolled hospitals have a private equity owner?
SELECT count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_all_owners WHERE private_equity_company_owner = 'Y'
Which countries' funders are acknowledged on the most PubMed papers?
SELECT country, count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_grants WHERE country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many categories of federal award does USAspending distinguish?
Which parent companies won the most federal contract dollars in fiscal 2024?

SELECT recipient_parent_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND recipient_parent_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many clinicians earned a perfect MIPS score of 100?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_ec_score_file WHERE try_cast(final_mips_score AS double) = 100
Which congressional districts reach into the most counties?

SELECT s.usps || '-' || substr(r.geoid_cd119_20, 3, 2) AS district, count(DISTINCT r.geoid_county_20) AS counties FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_cd11920_county20 r JOIN govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_state s ON s.geoid = substr(r.geoid_cd119_20, 1, 2) WHERE try_cast(r.arealand_part AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Energy Department research records were published each recent year?
SELECT substr(cast(publication_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_research.osti_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states enrolled the most public school students in 2024-25?

SELECT statename, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the federal government owe in 1790?
SELECT try_cast(debt_outstanding_amt AS double) AS debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_outstanding WHERE record_date = '1790-01-01'
Which counties in New York have the highest median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
